verdict.rationale: The only product-level hint of user-controlled recurring work is Fieldwork's marketing claim that its AI agents collect, validate, and package evidence "on your schedule." That phrase is vague and has no documented scheduling configuration behind it. The once-a-day repository scan is a fixed platform cadence, not a recurring job the user schedules, so it earns no credit. Missing for 10: documented user-defined recurring schedules (cron or interval), scheduling of arbitrary workflows or jobs, API/MCP access to create or manage schedules, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: Fieldwork’s AI agents collect, validate, and package the evidence – across your enterprise systems, on your schedule.
